info.name: Returns fields for the resource type and its target type in the Global context.

params.name: resourceType
params.description: The Resource Type. Accepted values: workitems, documents, testruns and plans.

params.name: targetType
params.description: The Type of the object. Use '~' without quotes to represent no target Type.

items.docs: Metadata support is limited to the following resource types: **Work Items**, **Documents**, **Test Runs**, and **Plans**.
